mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% relative to the prior 3 months reduces discount rates for equity valuation, increasing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 1.0% each indicate weakening consumer demand and reduced business investment, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 1.0% and RSAFS falls > 1.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary economic regime (GDP growth decline), a federal funds rate reduction relative to the prior 3 months increases liquidity and stimulates equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 declines by more than 0.5% in 3 months and FEDFUNDS is reduced.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline exceeding 1.0% signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls by more than 1.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 thousand units in the prior month indicate weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate increase exceeding 3.0% over the prior 3 months signals rising cost pressures that erode corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 3.0% YoY in the prior 3 months.
